steps: Deployed the program to devnet (upgrade authority is the lab wallet; max-len 3000000)
initialize_protocol dispute_threshold=51, fee_bps=100, min_stake=1_000_000, 2-of-3 lab multisig (config BhScAVMz…; ProgramData 6FLRyNkS…)
Fetched protocol config (351 bytes): authority and treasury are the lab wallet
evidence.functional_evidence: initialize_protocol verified; register_agent and create_task were not completed because this production build starts paused until stamp_release_surface (ProtocolPaused).
evidence.ui_check: The hosted page is the generic IDL console (connect Phantom or Solflare on devnet). initialize_protocol is already done; register_agent is expected to fail with ProtocolPaused until the protocol is stamped and unpaused.

limitations: The production (non-canary) build starts protocol_paused=true until stamp_release_surface; register_agent therefore failed with ProtocolPaused and create_task was not sent. The hosted IDL is a hand-derived subset (initialize_protocol, plus unverified register_agent/create_task account layouts). The on-chain program is large (~2.4 MiB).
